main.description: Remove an account from the requester's list of system accounts; the entry is deleted, not kept. Idempotent: an account not on the list is success. The requester's token lives at most 65 seconds and is accepted once. Requires auth; any signed-in account.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed or account is not a DID.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The requester's token lives over 65 seconds or was already used (HTTP 401).

errors.name: MethodNotImplemented
errors.description: System accounts are not served by this AppView (HTTP 501).
